item.description:
Point Translate 0.11.1
Ordinary text selection now leaves your clipboard alone. Select text and press Command + Option + C to translate and copy when you want to.
Automatic selection copying is off by default, including after upgrading. You can enable it explicitly in Settings. Ordinary photo drags also require that opt-in; the photo selection tool and Option + Shift lens remain available.
Includes the current retro interface and animated introduction, with instructions for deliberate copying. Clipboard undo and protection against overwriting a newer copy remain in place.
